title: Blood Training
summary: Exposed by Min-Jae's broadcast, Director Kang injects himself with an experimental Chimera Core. Captain Baek turns his blade against the corrupt Director, joining Ha-Jun in a historic alliance.

panels.shot: giant jumbotron displaying chimera files wide shot
panels.action: The 50-foot traffic jumbotron displays horrifying footage of Bureau bio-labs and Tae-Jun's stasis pod.

panels.shot: hunters murmuring in confusion and outrage
panels.action: Elite hunters lower their gear, looking up at the screen in horrified betrayal.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_sergeant
dialogue.text: Yeh files real hain... Bureau khud demon experiments kar raha tha?!

panels.shot: captain baek turning slowly to face director kang
panels.action: Captain Baek turns his armored body toward the carrier roof, eyes burning with icy rage behind his visor.

panels.shot: baek pointing greatsword at director kang
panels.action: Baek points the tip of his six-foot Eclipse Greatsword directly at Director Kang's throat.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: DIRECTOR KANG!! Is video ka kya matlab hai?! Mere saare comrades... Kya unhe aapne sacrifice kiya tha?!

panels.shot: director kang laughing maniacally on carrier roof
panels.action: Director Kang throws his head back, laughing with unhinged, psychopathic arrogance.

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Sacrifice? Woh sab weaklings the, Baek! Evolution ke raaste mein unka koi use nahi tha!

panels.shot: director kang pulling glowing black-purple syringe
panels.action: Kang pulls a pressurized pneumatic injector loaded with an undulating black-purple liquid core.

panels.shot: plunging syringe into his own carotid artery
panels.action: With a terrifying grin, Director Kang slams the injector directly into his neck artery.

panels.shot: director kang body violently convulsing
panels.action: Kang's human skin splits open along his spine; black demonic ichor and jagged obsidian spikes erupt outward.

panels.shot: carrier roof collapsing under monstrous weight
panels.action: The reinforced steel armored carrier groans and buckles as Kang's mass triples into a nine-foot Chimera Fiend.

panels.shot: chimera director kang full reveal
panels.action: A nightmarish fusion: four glowing purple eyes, obsidian chitinous armor, two demonic horns, and razor-tentacles.

dialogue.speaker: chimera_kang
dialogue.text: HUMANS ARE OBSOLETE! MAIN KHUD NAYA SOVEREIGN BANOONGA!!

panels.shot: chimera kang leaping at captain baek with tentacle whip
panels.action: Kang launches a 30-foot serrated chitinous tentacle whip straight at Captain Baek's skull.

panels.shot: ha-jun blurring in front of baek
panels.action: Ha-Jun appears instantaneously in front of Baek, his left bone gauntlet catching the tentacle mid-strike.

panels.shot: baek staring at ha-jun back in awe
panels.action: Captain Baek stares at the 17-year-old boy who just saved his life from his own commander.

panels.shot: ha-jun igniting violet hellfire down tentacle
panels.action: Ha-Jun channels the Flame of the Fallen through his grip; violet hellfire races up the tentacle toward Kang.

panels.shot: chimera kang shrieking as tentacle incinerates
panels.action: The demonic tentacle burns into purple ash in milliseconds; Kang shrieks, severing the limb in agony.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking over shoulder at baek
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks back with dual-ringed eyes: 'Captain... Sath mein ladte hain?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh monster na human hai na true demon. Iska hisaab hum dono mil kar karenge.

panels.shot: captain baek gripping greatsword with two hands
panels.action: Baek steps up beside Ha-Jun, his heavy blade humming with fierce righteous aura: 'Saath mein.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Puri zindagi main galat dushman se lad raha tha... Aaj asli dushman ko kaatunga!

panels.shot: kuro screeching overhead battle anthem
panels.action: Kuro glides in a halo of purple lightning: 'The Sovereign and the Hunter Captain! Tear him apart!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: SHOW HIM WHAT TRUE POWER LOOKS LIKE!!

panels.shot: dual charge: ha-jun and baek sprinting together
panels.action: Ha-Jun with flaming twin blood blades and Baek with the heavy Eclipse Greatsword charge in sync.

panels.shot: chimera kang spewing torrent of black acid bile
panels.action: Kang opens his unhinged triple-jaw, spewing a 50-foot wave of flesh-melting demonic acid.

panels.shot: ha-jun bone gauntlet forming expanding riot shield
panels.action: Ha-Jun thrusts his bone gauntlet forward; interlocking ivory plates expand into a 10-foot ballistic aegis.

panels.shot: acid splashing harmlessly off bone aegis
panels.action: The corrosive acid hisses and evaporates against the diamond-density bone shield without causing a scratch.

panels.shot: captain baek vaulting off ha-jun bone shield
panels.action: Using the top rim of Ha-Jun's bone shield as a launch pad, Captain Baek catapults 20 feet into the air.

panels.shot: baek executing two-handed downward guillotine cleave
panels.action: Baek brings the 200-pound greatsword down with the entire weight of his momentum.

panels.shot: cleaving chimera kang left arm clean off
panels.action: The greatsword shears clean through Kang's massive spiked left arm, pinning the limb to the tarmac.

panels.shot: ha-jun dropping shield and darting beneath kang torso
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides beneath the roaring beast, driving both flaming blood katanas upward into its core chest.

panels.shot: violet hellfire erupting inside chimera chest
panels.action: Violet-crimson flames detonate inside Kang's thoracic cavity, incinerating the synthetic demon core.

panels.shot: chimera kang collapsing onto burning knees
panels.action: The towering monstrosity collapses to its knees, demon flesh dissolving back into withered human corpse.

panels.shot: director kang dying whisper
panels.action: Director Kang coughs black blood, looking up at Ha-Jun with dying horror: 'Tum... Tumhe lagta hai yeh jeet hai...?'

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Abyss ka Gate... khul chuka hai... Woh aa rahe hain...

panels.shot: kang dissolving completely into black soot
panels.action: Director Kang dissolves into a pile of foul black ash, washed away by the heavy Seoul rain.
